tagline.en_US: Healthchecks is a watchdog for your cron jobs. It's a web server that listens for pings from your cron jobs, plus a web interface.

description.en_US: Healthchecks is a watchdog and monitoring service for cron jobs and scheduled tasks. It operates as a web service that listens for periodic pings sent by your automated jobs. When a ping does not arrive on schedule or reports an error, it alerts you through supported notification channels.
